Definition: to be (causatively, make) bitter (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be bitter; 1a) (Qal) to be bitter; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to show bitterness; 1b2) to make bitter; 1c) (Hiphil) to make bitter, embitter; 1d) (Hithpalpel); 1d1) to embitter oneself; 1d2) to be enraged; 2) (TWOT) to be strong, strengthen
